correctness.rationale: Using the source notation, on the region where the cutoff equals one the splitting numerator is exactly \(E=\Delta+(q-\Delta)\psi=\psi q+(1-\psi)\Delta\). With \(q\ge0\), \(\psi\ge1\), and \(\Delta\le0\), both summands are nonnegative. If \(q^{-1}(0)=C_\tau\subset\{\Delta<0\}\), equality occurs exactly when \(q=0\) and \(\psi=1\), giving \(C_\tau\times C_\phi\). The source construction is strictly positive outside the nonpositive-splitting region. Stagewise relative deletions leave total length \(L\prod_{j\le n}(1-\rho_j)\); continuity from above and Fubini give the area product and the logarithmic infinite-product criterion. For constant \(\rho\), the two-coordinate product is a four-map self-similar set of common ratio \((1-\rho)/2\), so the stated Hausdorff dimension follows from the similarity equation.
